page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head "COMMENTARII" at the top, with the page number 62 at the top left. No catchword or signature. Headings: "Epodus 1. versuum 9." (small centred title) and "De Hellanodicis iudicibus." (centred). Greek is printed inline throughout.

main_text.p: σις[?],hoc est, carminis compositio,& ἀρσις,& θέσις, quæ viua voce exprimitur. Concurrunt ergo hæc tria in hoc officii genere: Citharæ sonus, Tibiarum concentus, & viuæ vocis modulatio, quæ suauissimam reddent laudem Theronis.
Αἰνησιδάμου.[?]) Ἀναφώνησις propositionis, principalis enim scopus est Theronem laudare, idque ἀρχηγέτας[?].
Ἁ, τὰ Πίσα.[?]) Quinta causa impellens, ipsa Pisa, hoc est, locus ipse certaminum Olympicorum. at transitum hinc idoneum venatur ad digressionem de Herculis historia, & peregrinatione ad Hyperboreos.

Τὰς ἀπὸ.[?]) Commendatio loci ab utilitate. Pisa locus est à quo ad omnes mortales redundat gloria. Dignus ergo est vel solus, ut aliquid in eius laudem componam.Obser-ua vocum metathesin τὰς ἀπὸ, pro ὑπὸ τῆς, (scil. Πίσας. Θεόμο-ρᾳ Doricum pro Θεόμοιρᾳ, hoc est, Θεοδώρητοι[?], diuinitus dati cantus.
main_text.head: Epodus 1. versuum 9.
main_text.p: Victores describit ab instituto Herculis de ritu coronandi per Hellanodicas: inde digreditur in historiam de origine oleæ in Pisis.

ὠ τινι κεχιμένων[?].) Scholia dicunt a plurali Pindarum deficere ad singularem numerum: nam ἀνθρώπος[?] dixerat, cui respondet singulare ὤ τινι[?], cui: tamen referrem ad Αἰνησιδάμου πυγμῆς[?], singulare, reliqua parenthesi interpolita: Notantur autem legitimi victores, qui à iudice coronatur circa tempora oleæ ramo. Epitheta iudicis ἀτρεκής[?] à iustitia, & ἀμπελώς[?] ἀνὴρ à patria. Oxylum hunc primum iudicem dictum esse aiunt, & Ætolum fuisse, & Heraclidis in Peloponnesum migrantibus ducem itineris fuisse, qui memores beneficii Eliorum dominatum illi permiserunt, unde Elii Ætoli dici coeperunt. Ὑφοδὲν[?] ad βλεφάρων[?] refertur: & ἀμφὶ[?] per tmesin à verbo βάλλω[?] avulsum est.
Dicendum autem hic de Hellanodicis, quod locus id hic postulet.
main_text.head: De Hellanodicis iudicibus.
main_text.p: Ἑλλανοδίκης[?] significat Græcorum iudicem. Varinus vocem hanc interpretatur, inquiens, Ἑλλανοδίκῃ[?] dicuntur ἄρχοντες.

page.notes: Greek passages are read from a small, worn print. Accents and breathings in the commentary lemmata (Αἰνησιδάμου, ἀρχηγέτας, Ἁ τὰ Πίσα, Θεοδώρητοι, ὠ τινι κεχιμένων, ἀνθρώπος, ἀτρεκής, ἀμπελώς, Ὑφοδὲν, βλεφάρων, ἀμφὶ, βάλλω) are doubtful and marked [?]. The first word of the page is a fragment, continued from the previous page. Latin spelling was normalised: u/v and i/j by rule, "auulsum" as avulsum, "Elij" as Elii, "beneficij" and "officij" as beneficii and officii. The printed "componam.Obser-ua" has no space after the full stop, and this is kept as printed. The stray small mark in the left margin at mid-page is not printed text and was left out.
